optimizedDescription.value: Unique named unit for specs, code, schemas, and ownership; every spec belongs to exactly one workspace.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace

## Rules
- Unique name in `specd.yaml`; `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`. Reserved: `default` (mandatory local), `root` (project-global graph). Windows device names `con`, `prn`, `aux`, `nul`, `com1`–`com9`, `lpt1`–`lpt9` rejected on every OS when whole name equals device name; `con-foo` legal. No two workspaces share a name.
- Props: `specs` always; `codeRoot` required non-`default` (default ws → project root); `schemas` optional (default ws `specd/schemas`, else none); `ownership` optional (default ws `owned`, else `readOnly`); `prefix` optional; `contextIncludeSpecs` optional (non-default default `['*']`); `contextExcludeSpecs` optional. Relative paths resolve from `specd.yaml` dir.
- `isExternal` inferred when `specs` path resolves outside repo root — never declared. Affects ownership defaults and change validation.
- Ownership: `owned` (freely propose) / `shared` (co-own; coordination) / `readOnly` (read, no modify). Affects change targeting and approval gates. `shared`≡`owned` for writes.
- `readOnly` MUST reject with `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError`: (1) `change create --spec` / `change edit --add-spec` — spec cannot enter `specIds`; (2) `ArchiveChange` if any change spec is `readOnly` (defense-in-depth; MUST NOT silently merge deltas); (3) `SpecRepository.save()` and `SpecRepository.saveMetadata()` — lowest-level, unbypassable. Errors MUST state blocked op and why (`readOnly`); MUST NOT suggest remediation (e.g. change ownership in `specd.yaml`). Reads allowed: load, list, context deps, `dependsOn`.
- `prefix` prepended to capability paths: disk `architecture/` → `<prefix>/architecture`. Single- or multi-segment (`_global`, `team/shared/core`). Not a unique ID; two workspaces may share it. Absent → bare capability paths. Invalid syntax → `ConfigValidationError` at startup.
- Spec IDs `workspace:capabilityPath`; colon separates; `/` belongs to capability path. Bare path = `default:path`. Unknown qualifier rejected. Internally always fully-qualified; bare is user-facing only.
- Active workspace: ≥1 change `specIds` belongs to it. Derived at runtime by `workspaces` getter via `parseSpecId()` — not persisted. Controls which workspace-level context patterns apply.
- Primary workspace = first entry in `change.workspaces`. Used for archive template `{{change.workspace}}` and default metadata attribution when archiving.
- Port-per-workspace: use cases receive `ReadonlyMap<string, RepositoryInstance>` keyed by workspace name. Composition builds one repository per configured workspace.
- `contextIncludeSpecs` / `contextExcludeSpecs` apply only when workspace active. Bare qualifier means this workspace (not `default`). `['*']` = all specs here; `['auth/*']` = under `auth/` here. Evaluated after project-level patterns. Specs reached via `dependsOn` never subject to exclude patterns.
- Cross-ws refs OK in `dependsOn`, context patterns, delta targets (`billing:payments/invoices`). Schema refs use `#workspace:name` for another workspace's local schemas. Unknown workspace: config validation → error (abort); runtime context compilation → warning and skip.
- Change artifacts always include workspace segment, even single-workspace: `specs/<workspace>/<capability-path>/<artifact-filename>`; `deltas/<workspace>/<capability-path>/<artifact-filename>.delta.yaml`.
- Consuming project's `specd.yaml` is sole SoT. External repo `specd.yaml` never read. Paths, schemas, ownership, prefix independently declared.

## Constraints
- Every project declares a default workspace.
- Name regex enforced; whole-name Windows device names rejected on every OS.
- `codeRoot` required for non-default workspaces.
- `isExternal` inferred, never declared.
- Spec IDs always workspace-qualified internally.
- `workspaces` derived from `specIds` via `parseSpecId()` — not persisted.
- Empty `specIds` → empty `workspaces`.
- Workspace-level excludes never apply to specs reached via `dependsOn`.
- External repository configurations never read.
- Change artifacts always include the workspace path segment.
- `readOnly` rejects all writes: change scope additions, archive merges, direct spec writes.
- `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` messages must not suggest remediation.
